sources.title: Thomson Reuters bets $40M on owning its AI instead of renting from ...
sources.snippet: Key Points Thomson Reuters has built "Thomson," its own AI language model for legal work, on top of Alibaba's Qwen. The $40 million model was trained on the company's own data and by its domain experts. In testing, though, it only beats rivals like GPT-5.4 when it can access exclusive company content.
